gear.note: Ring gear is fixed. Output angle a (rad, about +Z): set DRV_out_<s>.rotation_euler.z = a (pivot Empty on the column axis; carrier plate, 3 planets, output shaft and encoder disc are its children), DRV_sun_<s>.rotation_euler.z = ratio * a, each DRV_planet_<i>_<s>.rotation_euler.z = -3 * a (local spin about its own axis), WING_<s>.rotation_euler.z = a. Wing open: a = +90 deg for L, -90 deg for R.

wave_u.note: every LED part has a child <name>_diffuser_<s> (material LED_DIFFUSER) carrying the same wave_u as the chips under it

grow_t.note: 0..1 along each cable from its first end to its last (plugs carry the value of their end). Optional: lets a cable be "laid" along its path (hide where grow_t > x) instead of dropping it in; cables 0 and 1 run under the column in the base channel.

uv.SCREEN_LCD: RAIL_lcd_<s>: 0..1 over the screen, v towards +Y (away from the user), u to the user's right
uv.SCREEN_WING: WING_display_<s>: 0..1 over the layer, v up, u to the right when seen from the entry side (-Y)
uv.BADGE: RAIL_badge_<s>: 0..1 over the front face, v up, u to the right when seen from the lane
uv.PCB_GREEN: ELE_pcb_<s> (and the small rail PCBs): 0..1 over the board

props.name: PROP_card
props.note: lies flat, long side along Y, centred over the card-tap icon of the L rail, 1.5 mm above the lid; hidden or animated by the director
